macro_objective: Students find and compare percentages of a whole and use them to reason about everyday quantities.

mls_units.title: Finding Percentages
mls_units.macro_alignment: Gives students the two methods, fraction of 100 and unit percent, that they will use on every percentage problem in the next unit.

tasks.action: Draw a 10 by 10 grid on the board and shade 35 squares. Explain that 35 out of 100 is 35 percent, and write 35% = 35/100 = 0.35.
Work three examples on the board of finding a percentage of an amount by first finding 1 percent, then multiplying.
In pairs, students solve ten practice questions from the board in their notebooks. One partner solves while the other checks each step, then they swap for the next question.
Write both methods on chart paper with one worked example each, and keep the chart for MLS-PERCENT-02.

mls_units.title: Percentages of a Whole
mls_units.macro_alignment: Uses the two percentage methods to work out and compare what share of a total each part takes.

tasks.action: Recall from MLS-PERCENT-01: put up the chart of the two percentage methods. Work two examples on the board of finding what percentage one amount is of a total.
In pairs, solve the eight word problems on the board. Partners take turns: one solves, the other checks the working, then they swap.
Go through the answers with the whole class, working on the board any problem that several pairs got wrong.
Each student writes three word problems of their own about percentages of a total and solves them in their notebook.
